jobs.title: Software engineer
jobs.description:
### **HIGHLIGHTS VAN DEZE VACATURE**


✔ Werken aan complexe procesinstallaties binnen industriële automatisering, weg uit generieke softwareklussen. ✔ Ontwerpen, programmeren en testen van PLC\-software in Siemens TIA Portal en PCS7\. ✔ Aan de slag bij een ervaren procesautomatiseerder met winstdeling en ontwikkelkansen.
### **DIT GA JE DOEN**


Als Software Engineer ontwikkel jij besturingssoftware voor uiteenlopende procesinstallaties binnen de industriële automatisering. Je krijgt te maken met kleinere systemen én grote, complexe installaties, zoals stoomketels, afvalverbrandingslijnen, composteringsinstallaties, drogers, warmtenetten en andere procesgebonden systemen. Op basis van klantspecificaties werk jij een functioneel ontwerp uit, beoordeel je de aangeleverde eisen kritisch en vertaal je deze naar een helder technisch concept. Daarna bouw je de software in vaste ontwikkelomgevingen zoals Siemens TIA Portal en PCS7, test je de applicaties samen met de klant en begeleid je de inbedrijfstelling ter plaatse. Zo draag jij concreet bij aan installaties die aantoonbaar efficiënter, stabieler en toekomstbestendig draaien. In jouw rol ziet dat er samengevat zo uit:  

* Opstellen en uitwerken van functionele ontwerpen op basis van klantspecificaties.
* Vertalen van eisen en wensen naar een gestructureerde softwarearchitectuur in Siemens TIA Portal of PCS7\.
* Programmeren en configureren van PLC\- en besturingssoftware voor diverse procesinstallaties.
* Uitvoeren van tests samen met de klant en begeleiden van FAT en inbedrijfstelling op locatie.
* Analyseren van verbeterkansen en voorstellen doen om installaties slimmer en efficiënter te laten draaien.


De functie is nu extra interessant omdat er continu nieuwe projecten starten rondom energiebesparing, verduurzaming en optimalisatie van bestaande procesinstallaties. Je werkt daardoor aan actuele vraagstukken in de procesautomatisering, met moderne tooling en direct zichtbare impact op de performance van industriële systemen.
### **DIT BRENG JE MEE**


In deze rol werk je nauwkeurig, denk je vanuit de installatie en stem je actief af met klanten en collega\-engineers. Je neemt eigenaarschap in je projecten, durft specificaties inhoudelijk te bevragen en blijft net zo lang doorzoeken tot de software aantoonbaar doet wat bedoeld is.  

* Hbo\-werk\- en denkniveau in een relevante technische richting, bijvoorbeeld industriële automatisering, elektrotechniek of vergelijkbaar.
* Minimaal twee jaar aantoonbare ervaring als software engineer of PLC\-engineer binnen industriële omgevingen.
* Goede kennis van PLC\-techniek en de gangbare softwarepakketten in het vakgebied, waaronder Siemens TIA Portal en PCS7\.


### **HIER KUN JE OP REKENEN**


Bij een werkweek van 32 tot 40 uur als Software Engineer gelden de volgende arbeidsvoorwaarden.

  

* € 3\.500,00 tot € 6\.000,00 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring.
* 27 vakantiedagen en 7 ADV\-dagen bij een fulltime dienstverband.
* Reiskostenregeling.
* Winstdelingsregeling op basis van de resultaten van de organisatie.
* Telefoonregeling en een laptop van de zaak als onkostenvoorzieningen.
* 8% vakantiegeld.
* Werkgeversbijdrage van 2/3de aan het pensioen.


Daarnaast zijn er nog meer arbeidsvoorwaarden en ontwikkelmogelijkheden die we graag in een persoonlijk gesprek concreet met je doornemen. Reageer direct als deze rol als Software Engineer inhoudelijk bij jouw volgende stap past. Je krijgt altijd binnen 1 werkdag een reactie op je sollicitatie. Neem voor vragen of een eerste verkenning contact op met Nick Jansen via 06 \- 25 48 11 44\.


### **HIER GA JE WERKEN**


Je komt terecht bij een middelgrote speler in de procesautomatisering die complete oplossingen levert voor industriële installaties, van haalbaarheidsstudie tot engineering, paneelbouw, montage, inbedrijfstelling en nazorg. De organisatie bestaat uit circa 140 medewerkers, waarvan ongeveer 20 collega’s op de locatie in Veenendaal werken, en is al meer dan 25 jaar actief in Nederland en daarbuiten met projecten voor uiteenlopende procesinstallaties en warmtenetten.  

  

Binnen het engineeringteam werk je samen met andere software\-, hardware\- en projectengineers die inhoudelijk sterk zijn en actief kennis delen. De cultuur is direct en technisch gedreven, met korte lijnen naar de leidinggevenden en veel ruimte om in projecten mee te denken over de beste oplossing. Je werkt op een moderne kantoorlocatie, hebt overleg aan het projectbureau en schakelt regelmatig met de werkplaats en buitendienst. Er wordt bewust geïnvesteerd in het opleiden van jonge engineers en het overdragen van ervaring, zodat je kunt groeien in het vak en samen met je collega’s bouwt aan langdurige technische kwaliteit.

### **£50,000\+ (plus enhanced benefits, incl. Leisure \& Golf Club membership)**


At CGP we develop all business systems and digital products from our offices on the edge of the beautiful Lake District. Why do it all ourselves? The answer's simple. It's all about high standards and trust — we need to have total trust in our systems, products and people to ensure we deliver annual sales of c. £40m.


**Who are we looking for?**
  

  

If you're an **experienced developer** with **C\# experience** (ideally in an Ecommerce environment) who's knocking on the door of a senior position, this could be just the role for you. We'll take all the usual skills for granted — **SOLID** design principles, **Agile** delivery methods, **MVC** and **MVVM**. The hard bit is finding the **right sort of person** to join the team.


You'll likely have a STEM degree from a top university, but provided you're:


* Open\-minded and flexible
* Logical and quick to pick things up
* Driven by high standards
* Able to work within an agreed structure
* Self\-motivated and a problem solver...

...you could have a great career at CGP.


There are no barriers to progression — it's all down to you and what you deliver. To find out more about CGP, check out our **Great Place to Work video**.


We believe the best way for great ideas to flourish is to **work on site** alongside your colleagues, so this isn't a role where you'll sit at home with rare human contact. A **hybrid** arrangement can happen in time, but this shouldn't be what drives you.

jobs.title: Staff InfoSec Engineer
jobs.description:
Krakow, Poland Category Engineering, Product, \& UX Design
  
Job description
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high\-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close\-knit, high\-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.
  

  

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.
**Staff InfoSec Engineer**
**Why We Have This Role**


Qualtrics is looking for a Senior Lead of CDU Operations to lead the (Kraków) team’s daily operations that are responsible for detecting, triaging, and responding to security threats across our global environment. You'll own the day\-to\-day operations of your team, build and mentor a high\-performing team of analysts, and continuously mature our detection and response capabilities to keep pace with an evolving threat landscape. This is a hands\-on leadership role — you'll support in guiding strategy while staying close enough to work alongside the team and manage incidents.
**How You’ll Find Success**


* Strategic Visionary: You possess an in\-depth understanding of the cybersecurity threat landscape and proactively identify emerging risks. You help shape the Security Operations strategy, ensuring alignment with the organization's overall goals.
* Technical Innovator: You drive continuous improvement by evaluating and implementing cutting\-edge security tools, techniques, and automation. Your relentless pursuit of innovation keeps us ahead of evolving threats.
* Collaborative Leader: You build strong cross\-functional partnerships, championing security across the organization. You foster a collaborative environment where teams work seamlessly to achieve a strong security posture.
* Resilient and Adaptive: You thrive in a dynamic environment, effectively managing complex security projects and leading teams through change. Your ability to adapt and problem\-solve makes you a key asset during challenging situations.

**How You’ll Grow**


* Shape Industry Standards: Participate in leading security conferences, thought leadership initiatives, and industry working groups to shape the future of cybersecurity practices.
* Executive Presence: Gain direct exposure to executive\-level decision\-making, refining your strategic communication and influencing skills.
* Expand Your Leadership Toolkit: Lead a team of skilled security professionals, providing you with ample opportunities to enhance your mentorship, coaching, and talent development abilities.
* Complex Problem\-Solving: Tackle high\-impact security challenges that will push your critical thinking, analysis, and strategy\-building skills.

**Things You’ll Do**


* Lead and manage the Security Operations Center, including 24x7 monitoring, detection, triage, and incident response functions
* Hire, coach, and develop a team of CDU analysts and incident responders; build career paths and a strong on\-call/rotation culture
* Senior Lead needs hands\-on credibility. Conduct 1\-on\-1 technical coaching, run mock incident drills, and build skill matrices for junior analysts.
* Own CDU metrics and KPIs (MTTD, MTTR, alert volume/fidelity, coverage) and report on program health to security leadership
* Drive continuous improvement of detection logic, playbooks, and automation in partnership with detection engineering and threat intelligence teams
* Serve as an escalation point and incident commander for high\-severity security incidents, coordinating cross\-functional response
* Partner with Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering, IT, Legal, and Product/Engineering teams to close gaps in visibility and response
* Manage relationships with any outsourced/MSSP or co\-managed CDU partners, ensuring SLAs and quality standards are met
* Evaluate and help select CDU tooling (SIEM, SOAR, EDR, XDR, ticketing) and drive adoption of automation to reduce analyst toil
* Own CDU\-related audit, compliance, and customer trust requirements (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP as applicable)
* Build and maintain incident response runbooks, tabletop exercises, and post\-incident review processes
* Participate in an on\-call rotation for incidents and provide leadership presence during major security events

**What We’re Looking For On Your Resume**


* Required:
	+ 7\+ years in security operations, incident response, or a related security discipline, including 4\+ years in a people\-management or team\-lead role
	+ Demonstrated experience running or scaling a 24x7 CDU function, whether in\-house, hybrid, or via MSSP oversight
	+ Strong technical grounding in SIEM/SOAR platforms, EDR/XDR, network and cloud security monitoring, and the MITRE ATT\&CK framework
	+ Experience leading incident response for significant security events, including coordination with legal, communications, and executive stakeholders
	+ Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining security talent
	+ Excellent communication skills — able to translate technical detail into risk\-based language for non\-technical leaders
	+ Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and SaaS security operations
* Nice to Have:
	+ Experience in a SaaS or enterprise software company handling customer data at scale
	+ Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to Qualtrics' customer base (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, GDPR)
	+ Relevant certifications (CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, CISM, or similar)
	+ Experience building or maturing threat detection and threat hunting programs
	+ Background in scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell) to support SOAR workflows

**What You Should Know About This Team**


* Innovation at Our Core: Our Security Operations team embraces change and thrives on solving complex challenges. We value experimentation, continuous learning, and push the boundaries of conventional security practices.
* Collaborative Environment: We believe in the power of teamwork and foster open communication across the team and the wider organization. Your ideas will be heard, and your collaboration will be essential.
* Data\-Driven Approach: We rely on data\-driven insights to inform our security strategies, measure effectiveness, and continuously improve our posture.
* Growth Mindset: We are committed to your professional development. You'll have opportunities to expand your expertise, contribute to high\-visibility projects, and advance your career in cybersecurity.
* Joining our team means stepping into a role that's vital, challenging, and deeply linked to Qualtrics' aim of reshaping industries by harnessing the power of Experience Management and AI.
**Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits**


* Annual Leave: 20 or 26 annual leave days per annum plus an additional day for each year of service (to a max of 5\).
* Private Medical Insurance\- Luxmed health \& dental cover for you and your dependants.
* Commuter Assistance\- Up to the value of 80 PLN net a month for public transport.
* Savings Plan\- Two company saving plans provided by Nationale Nederlanden: Employee Capital Plan (PPK) \& Employee Saving Plan (PPO),
* QED PROGRAM\- Qualtrics Engineer Development (QED) program: support, engineering learning activities up to 10% of engineering work time each quarter.
* Wellness\- Up to the value of 800PLN gross per quarter can be reimbursed for a variety of wellness activities via our dedicated platform Forma,
* A choice of Multispot cards available.
* Our employee assistance program with Unum provides counselling and wellbeing support to all employees
* Experience bonus\- 7000 PLN gross per annum. Qualtrics experience bonus is a program designed to provide experiences to our employees they might not otherwise have.
* Group Life \& Income Protection Insurance
* Glasses/Contact lenses Reimbursement
* Free breakfasts, lunches, snacks, and drinks for everyone in the office
* Tax\-deductible expenses (up to 50% depending on role)

**The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model**: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in\-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. \#hybrid

If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.*

jobs.title: AI Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
AI is already changing how work gets done at CatalystOne. We're looking for someone who can design, build and operate AI solutions that create real business value, removing manual work, improving processes and helping colleagues focus on higher\-value work.


The whole company is your remit, the work is already underway, and we're small enough that something you build can be used by colleagues within weeks. This is an opportunity to help shape an AI practice from the beginning and see your work create visible impact across the business.


At CatalystOne, we help organisations create better workplaces through HR technology. Across the Nordics, we combine technology, people expertise and business understanding to help customers improve how work gets done. We're now applying the same thinking internally as we continue to expand how AI supports our own organisation.

### **About the AI Hub**


The AI Hub is a new function within People \& Technology, created to help CatalystOne identify, prioritise and realise the value of AI across the business.


We don't see AI as purely a technology topic. Introducing AI changes how work is organised, what people need to learn, and where human judgement matters most. We want those conversations considered together, close to the people doing the work.


The purpose of the AI Hub is to bring together process improvement, organisational change and technology to help teams work better and deliver stronger outcomes. As our AI Operations Engineer, you'll play a key role in turning ideas into solutions that people use every day.

### **The role**


Your users are your colleagues.


You'll build the systems, automations and AI\-powered solutions that consultants, support teams, sales teams and back\-office functions rely on to do their work. You'll work directly with the people experiencing the problem, helping shape solutions that fit how work actually happens.


This is a small team with a short path from idea to implementation. Some opportunities can move from a conversation on Monday to a solution in production that same week. Others require deeper technical design, data modelling or integration work. You'll help make those calls and take ownership of what gets built long after launch.


You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager to assess opportunities and agree scope. The AI Business Partner leads process improvement, adoption and value measurement. You lead technical design, engineering and operations. Both of you are involved while the problem is being defined and stay close after launch to ensure solutions create lasting value.


Some examples of what is already live


This isn't a greenfield AI initiative. We already have solutions creating value across CatalystOne today, including:

* An AI support agent that resolves around a fifth of internal IT tickets before they reach the IT team.
* Data products that save consultants time and provide business insights we didn't previously have.
* Automated workflows that reduce manual administration and move information seamlessly between teams.

The AI Hub exists to build on that foundation, helping CatalystOne identify the next opportunities, improve how work gets done, and ensure new solutions deliver measurable business value.

### **What you'll do**


You'll typically be involved throughout the entire lifecycle of a solution, from the first conversation through to operation and continuous improvement.


Your work will include:

* Building AI agents, automations and integrations that remove manual work and improve how teams operate.
* Working directly with colleagues to understand problems and shape practical solutions.
* Designing data models, workflows and integrations that support reliable AI solutions.
* Deciding where automation makes sense, where AI adds value and where human judgement should remain part of the process.
* Owning the solutions you build, including reliability, monitoring, security and cost management.
* Improving solutions based on how people actually use them.
* Creating documentation and reusable patterns that allow others to understand, maintain and extend your work.
### **Our technology stack**


Today we use Claude Code and Anthropic models, our own MCP servers running on Azure Container Apps, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions and Logic Apps. We already have agentic workflows running in production.


The tools will change. If something better comes along and you can make the case for it, you'll have room to improve the setup. Whatever we run needs to be secure, understandable, maintainable and cost\-effective.

### **What we're looking for**


We're less interested in a specific career path than in your ability to build reliable solutions that people depend on.


You'll likely bring:

* Experience building integrations, backend services, automations or internal platforms.
* Strong technical foundations in areas such as Azure, Microsoft Graph, APIs, serverless technologies, Python or C\#.
* Experience delivering AI\-powered solutions that real users rely on.
* Good technical judgement and the ability to choose simple solutions when they solve the problem.
* An understanding of security, reliability and operational ownership.
* Awareness of the trade\-offs between capability, speed, complexity and cost.
* The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical colleagues.

You care about the work behind the request, not just the technology. You want to understand how people use what you've built, whether they trust it and how it can be improved over time.


You don't need HR or HCM experience. If this sounds broadly like you, we'd love to hear from you.

### **What success looks like**


Your first few weeks will be about understanding our infrastructure, the solutions already running and the colleagues who use them.


You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager on new opportunities, helping assess what is technically possible and where the best place to start might be.


We want you building early, while giving you enough time to understand the environment you're responsible for.


By day 90, we'd expect you to have taken ownership of parts of the existing platform, contributed to new solutions entering production, and built strong relationships with the colleagues using them.

### **Why join CatalystOne?**


This is an opportunity to help build an AI practice from the beginning and see your work used by colleagues across the company.


You'll have the chance to:

* Build solutions that create visible business impact.
* Work directly with the people using what you build.
* Shape how the AI Hub develops.
* Experiment with modern AI technologies while staying focused on real business outcomes.
* Take ownership from idea through production and continuous improvement.

If you're excited by the opportunity to build practical AI solutions, solve meaningful business problems and help shape the future of work at CatalystOne, we'd love to hear from you.

### **Benefits**


As well as your salary, you’ll receive:

* Generous time off: A solid vacation allowance so you can recharge and regroup.
* Financial and health security: A comprehensive pension and insurance package, including private healthcare.
* Your well being, your way: A wellness contribution to help you stay on top of your health.
* Tech tools for efficiency: Laptop, mobile phone with subscription, and a home internet allowance.
* Flexible work setup: A hybrid model that supports your work life balance, with at least three days a week in the office.
* And more: Local benefits vary slightly by office, and we are happy to walk you through the details.
*CatalystOne does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. CatalystOne will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to the specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to CatalystOne on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.*

*We would like to inform you that all candidates who receive a job offer will be subject to a background check.*


  
Contact Mark Mc Daid People \& Talent Manager – People \& Technology
  
**About CatalystOne**
---------------------


CatalystOne is a Scandinavian leader of HCM\-software with over 250 employees throughout Norway, Sweden, Denmark, and India. We have, since 2004, built a strong value\-based company driven by our customers' success. Our culture is characterized by a unique combination of emphasis on results and on people. We have experienced high growth in recent years and have the ambition to continue this growth both in Scandinavia and in other North\-European countries.

  

CatalystOne is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, colour, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic.

**Fair Screening in our Recruitment process**


To promote fairness and reduce unconscious bias, candidates are anonymised during the initial screening stage. This means applications are reviewed based on skills, experience, and relevance to the role – not personal characteristics. Once shortlisted, recruiters review the full candidate profile and engage directly with candidates throughout the process.

**Use of AI**

We use AI‑supported tools in parts of our recruitment process to help structure and summarise applications, support screening, and transcribe interviews. These tools assist our recruiters but do not make decisions on their own – all evaluations and hiring decisions are made by people.



Founded in 2004
Co\-workers 250\+

jobs.description:
### **Onderneming**

### **Functie**


Om de verdere groei van het bedrijf te ondersteunen zijn we op zoek naar een **Backend Developer .NET**. In deze functie werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling, modernisering en verdere uitbouw van onze interne softwareoplossingen en het achterliggende servicelandschap.


Je bent verantwoordelijk voor:


* Het zelfstandig meewerken aan verschillende softwareprojecten, in nauwe samenwerking met andere developers, functionele analisten en de application architect.
* Het vertalen van functionele en business requirements naar technische oplossingen, en het actief meedenken over een passende en pragmatische technische aanpak.
* Het ontwikkelen, testen en onderhouden van backendservices en REST API's binnen een microservicearchitectuur.
* Het ontwikkelen van nieuwe toepassingen en services, maar ook het moderniseren en verder uitbouwen van bestaande oplossingen.
* Het werken met zowel synchrone als asynchrone communicatie tussen services, onder andere via REST API's en messaging.
* Het schrijven van onderhoudbare, testbare en consistente code volgens de afgesproken development\- en architectuurconventies.
* Het actief deelnemen aan code reviews en mee bewaken van de kwaliteit van de codebase.
* Het helpen verbeteren van onze development lifecycle, technische standaarden en development guidelines.
* Het actief opvolgen van relevante evoluties binnen het .NET\-ecosysteem en samen met het team beoordelen waar nieuwe technologie een meerwaarde kan bieden.

### **Profiel**


In deze functie verwachten we dat je zelfstandig kan werken, initiatief neemt en actief meedenkt over technische keuzes. Je werkt binnen een team van developers en analisten en kan technische beslissingen duidelijk onderbouwen en bespreken.


* Opleiding en ervaring – Je hebt een bachelor\- of masterdiploma Informatica of bent gelijkwaardig door ervaring. Je hebt minstens 3 jaar relevante ervaring als backend developer en een sterke interesse in softwareontwikkeling en softwarekwaliteit.
* **Analyse** – Je beschikt over een sterk analytisch vermogen. Je kan complexe problemen structureren, pragmatische oplossingen uitwerken en technische keuzes onderbouwen.
* **Zelfstandigheid en samenwerking** – Je kan zelfstandig taken opnemen en prioriteiten bewaken, maar werkt tegelijk graag samen met andere developers, analisten en architecten. Je communiceert duidelijk over technische keuzes, problemen en mogelijke oplossingen.
* **Can do** – Je bent leergierig, communiceert vlot en kan zelfstandig prioriteiten stellen.
* **Kwaliteitsgericht werken** – Je hecht belang aan leesbare en onderhoudbare code, geautomatiseerde tests, consistente ontwikkelstandaarden en degelijke code reviews.
* **Talenkennis** – Je beheerst vlot de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Kennis van Frans is een pluspunt.

**Technische kennis**
---------------------


Je hebt hands\-on ervaring met:


* **C\# en modern .NET**, bij voorkeur .NET 8 of recenter
* Het ontwikkelen van **REST API's** met ASP.NET Core
* **Entity Framework Core** en relationele databases, bij voorkeur SQL Server
* Asynchroon programmeren
* Dependency injection en gangbare .NET\-ontwikkelpatronen
* Git en een professionele development workflow met branches, pull requests en code reviews.


Ervaring met één of meerdere van onderstaande technologieën of concepten is een sterke meerwaarde:


* Microservice architectuur
* **CQRS** en event\-driven architectuur
* Asynchronous messaging, bijvoorbeeld met **MassTransit en RabbitMQ**
* **NoSQL** databases
* **Minimal APIs** en API\-versioning
* EF Core
* JWT\-gebaseerde authenticatie en autorisatie
* Automated testing met bijvoorbeeld **xUnit** en **Moq**
* CI/CD en work management via **Azure DevOps**
* Domeinmodellering en principes uit **Domain\-Driven Design** en **SOLID**, toegepast op een pragmatische manier
* Logging, monitoring en observability, bijvoorbeeld via Application Insights

### **Aanbod**


Wat bieden wij?

* Functie – Je maakt deel uit van het IT team en rapporteert aan Head of IT Architechture \& BI.
* Salaris – we bieden een competitief salarispakket bestaande uit een vast loon, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, hospitalisatieverzekering, groepsverzekering, firmawagen en 30% personeelskorting bij ZEB, The Fashion Store en PointCarré.
* Thuiswerkdag \- wekelijks een dag thuiswerk
* Een mooie werkplek en een toffe werksfeer, in een ambitieus en creatief team

We bring 120 years of successful mission support to improve security, streamline logistics, and enhance readiness. Aligned around a shared purpose, our $3\.9B company and 16,000 people work alongside our clients, here and abroad, to tackle their most complex challenges with integrity, respect, responsibility, and professionalism.**

Working within the Apex Connect team alongside cloud engineers, DevOps, and backend developers, you will lead the integration between Apex Connect and theHunter: Call of the Wild . What you'll do

You will be challenged with designing and building the next generation of our backend services. Balancing hands-on programming with technical strategy, you will work alongside senior developers to shape long-term architectural roadmaps, take ownership of core backend domains, and foster collaboration across teams and key stakeholders.

Our services are primarily implemented in Go, with parts extending into C++, Python, and JavaScript.

We are seeking someone with strong experience building scalable backend infrastructure and maintaining robust, reliable codebases. Prior games industry experience is a bonus, but not required.

Who you are

Minimum 5+ years of professional backend programming experience
Strong knowledge of backend programming in Go, Python, C#
Extensive experience from storage technologies such as MySQL, NoSQL, Redis or Memcache
Extensive experience running services in commercial clouds or Kubernetes
A great sense of technical excellence, functionality and problem-solving
Excellent verbal and written English

Knowledge of Javascript and C++

At Avalanche, we’re more about your drive to learn and interest in tackling challenges than what’s on your resume! So don’t stress if you don’t tick every box— shoot us your application anyway! The Stockholm location

Our Stockholm office is situated in Södermalm, the beating heart of the city’s game industry. Our values

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Ministry of Finance
jobs.description:
The Ministry of Finance is responsible for the Government Procurement (GP) policies, which govern how government agencies conduct their procurement. With evolving needs of our public officers and changing procurement landscape, MOF is embarking on the Whole of Government Procurement initiative.

GeBIZ X is the MOF product that would transform the procurement and business experience for WOG public officers and external suppliers.

Who we are looking for

We are seeking a dynamic Software Engineer that delivers high-quality code while contributing to technical excellence and team success. He develops sustainable features, follows engineering best practices, and participates in technical decision-making. Key responsibilities include writing maintainable code, collaborating within cross-functional teams, engaging in code reviews, addressing technical debt, and continuously improving their technical skills while contributing to a positive team culture. This role encompasses the product development lifecycle and ensures alignment with product roadmaps to meet both functional and nonfunctional requirements, including resiliency, security, performance, maintainability and supportability.

Who we are looking for

We are seeking a dynamic Software Engineer that delivers high-quality code while contributing to technical excellence and team success. He develops sustainable features, follows engineering best practices, and participates in technical decision-making. This role encompasses the product development lifecycle and ensures alignment with product roadmaps to meet both functional and nonfunctional requirements, including resiliency, security, performance, maintainability and supportability.

Our Team

We Our team is made up of passionate individuals committed to solving challenges and driving meaningful change. We embrace diversity of thought, encourage experimentation, and foster a culture of continuous learning. As part of this team, you will lead design direction and collaborate with UX designers, finance officers, and solution providers — forward-thinking professionals equally invested in your growth and in transforming MOF’s corporate finance services.

What you will be working on

Application Development

Product development, system integration and architecture design for applications used by public officers through partnership with Product Managers, Engineer Manager and UX Designer.

Ensure alignment with product roadmaps and requirements.

Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering Manager and UX Designer to translate business requirements into technical product roadmaps, including prototypes to validate business needs and proof of concepts.

Build prototypes to demonstrate technological opportunities

Write production quality code

Manage deployments to cloud infrastructure

Maintain systems to a high level of reliability

Deliver new features with technical sustainability, maintainability, and risk mitigation

Strong technical judgment in software design and architecture trade-offs in alignment with long-term goals.

Use metrics (e.g., delivery velocity, incident trends, performance) to guide decisions and improve flow

Achieve: Deliver Outcomes Sustainably

Proactively identifying and initiating worthwhile engineering initiatives to maximize our impact on the public good.

Establishing practices and tools to encourage a strong engineering culture and maximize engineering effectiveness and impact.

Ensure the high-quality product delivery, and improves over time

Support technical decision-making and architecture reviews

Monitor delivery health, reliability, and tech debt — and address root causes, not just symptoms

Improve Developer Experience (DevX) and reduce friction through better tools, processes, or team rituals

Partnership for Success

Partnering with stakeholders and agencies and understand the prioritised roadmaps for delivering towards product vision incrementally and efficiently.

Working with cross-functional partners to develop quality, reliability, and security strategies within your team.

Required Qualifications, Skills And Mindset

Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in relevant qualifications in any of the following: Computer Science, Computer or Electronics Engineering, Information Technology or related technical discipline

Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in DevOps software engineering using Agile methodologies e.g. SCRUM

Experience with Government Commercial Cloud (GCC), SHIP-HATS and SG Tech Stack (SGTS)

Strong knowledge of Java/ C# .Net programming language, restful APIs, ETL/ AWS Glue for data migration and database structures

Experience working in modern full-stack application technologies including SaaS, Bespoke and COTS solutions, in modern integration services, front-end and backend engineering

Proven track record of implementing large-scale, high-availability solutions, preferably in the public sector

Knowledge of data protection regulations and privacy considerations in the public sector

Experience working on reasonably large, high-availability software systems that have operated at scale.

Embrace modern governance, security, and platform practices

Understand the link between engineering culture, equity, and system health

Passion towards engineering excellence; you deeply understand that software engineering is a team sport, and you take pride in the craftsmanship aspect of software engineering.

Passion towards working for public good with interest.

The ability to work as a team to achieve important goals together.

Process good communication skills, ability to articulate technology concepts, participate in discussions on requirements with stakeholders

Please note that this will be a 2-year fixed term contract.
